description: Highly optimized global sourcing model with low cost but high hidden fragility.
Regionalized and diversified system with stronger continuity and adaptive capacity.
Trade fragmentation increases complexity while partial buffers reduce some exposure.
Supply system designed for climate disruption infrastructure risk and adaptive logistics.
Digital traceability AI planning and automation improve visibility but create cyber and governance risks.
Repair reuse recycling remanufacturing and reverse logistics reduce material dependency.
Public-interest supply model prioritizing continuity for essential goods and services.
Efficient but opaque chain with concentrated supplier exposure and weak accountability.
